== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page from the old Players Committee forum (Internet Archive captures). Sources used: topic 22209 (posts 320975, 320981, 321207, 321237, 321472).
Places come from first names only. Kevin is identified as [[Kevin Shannon]] (named among the players in post 321237; congratulated as "Kevin" in the thread; he ran the 2011 SoCal Grand Prix) and Aaron as [[Aaron Nelson]] (Airdog2003, signed "Aaron Nelson, Random guy from So Cal").
=== Missing data ===
* Surnames of the other top-four players, Kyle and Mike, and of the organizer Chris.
* Attendance and standings: the topic title says round-by-round results, but they are not in the posts read.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The [[List of SWCCG tournaments]] row gives 2 August 2008 (Players Committee news); the forum board gives "August 1st thru 3rd, 2008" for the weekend, which also held the Nevada State Championship on 1 August.
